arguments.content:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

# Create a tarball of the current repository root on each commit.
# Stored under .git/ so it won't pollute the working tree.

repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
timestamp=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
archive="$repo_root/.git/pre-commit-snapshots"
name="snapshot-$timestamp.tar.gz"

mkdir -p "$archive"

# Archive the entire working directory (including untracked), excluding the .git dir.
# Note: This captures the working tree as-is, not necessarily exactly what is staged.
(
  cd "$repo_root"
  tar -czf "$archive/$name" --exclude="./.git" .
)

printf '%s\n' "pre-commit: created $archive/$name" >&2
